description: This file contains functions for creating and configuring an OpenSearch client, including handling TLS certificates, custom CA, and connection settings.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates an OpenSearch client using provided configuration and handles connection errors.

methods.name: createClientConfig
methods.description: Builds and returns the OpenSearch client configuration, including TLS, authentication, and debugging options.

methods.name: configureCA
methods.description: Reads and sets the custom Certificate Authority (CA) certificate for the OpenSearch client.

methods.name: configureClientCertificate
methods.description: Reads client certificate and key files, loads them into TLS configuration for secure communication.
